text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for training, but Symboli Rudolf is nowhere to be found. Curious, I make my way to the student council office.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Zzz… Mm… Oh… Air Groove… It's you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, I find her dozing amid stacks of paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No… I don't need that chair moved… Heh… Chair move… Air Groove…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like she's sleeping peacefully, so I decide not to disturb her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please accept my earnest apologies for failing to keep to our schedule.
choice_data_list: Just be more careful next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. I will take pains to ensure that this does not happen again.
